User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile document containing account role and metadata

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when account profile was created

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp when user was last seen

activitySummary.description: Lightweight summary of meaningful user activity counts

notificationPreferences.description: User notification preferences across event categories

Feeling.title: Feeling Submission
Feeling.description: Unedited personal feeling submitted by user

userId.description: ID of the user submitting the feeling
ID of the user writing the letter

Activity.title: User Activity Event
Activity.description: Meaningful user activity event recorded in Starlit Letters

userId.description: ID of the user who performed the activity

section.description: Section in which the activity occurred

itemId.description: Identifier of the item interacted with

metadata.description: Optional metadata associated with event (excludes private text content)

PhotoBoothMemory.title: Photo Booth Memory
PhotoBoothMemory.description: User photo memory metadata captured in the Photo Booth

uid.description: Firebase user ID who captured and owns the photo

storagePath.description: Storage path where the compressed WebP photo is stored

downloadUrl.description: Storage download URL for the photo

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when photo was saved

cameraFacing.description: Camera facing mode used during capture

BtsActivity.title: Behind The Scenes Activity Event
BtsActivity.description: Activity event recorded when user interacts with Behind The Scenes content

userId.description: ID of the authenticated user who performed the BTS interaction

itemId.description: Identifier of the BTS item or view interacted with

itemType.description: Media type of the BTS item

Doodle.title: User Doodle Drawing
Doodle.description: Handmade drawing created by user in What Am I To You or Your Reflections

userId.description: User identifier who created the doodle

section.description: Section where the doodle was created

strokes.description: Array of stroke points and styling

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the doodle was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the doodle was last updated

NotificationToken.title: FCM Notification Token
NotificationToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging Web Push registration token for device notifications

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase user ID owning the token

token.description: Full FCM Web Push registration token

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when token was registered

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when token was refreshed or verified

enabled.description: Whether device notifications are currently enabled for this token

NotificationEvent.title: Notification Event
NotificationEvent.description: Queued notification event to be processed and delivered to user devices via Cloud Messaging

data.description: Optional payload data metadata such as eventKey, action URL, or content IDs

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was queued

processedAt.description: Timestamp when event began processing or null

sentAt.description: Timestamp when event was delivered or null if pending

failedTokenCount.description: Number of device tokens that failed delivery

failureReason.description: Failure details if status is failed

NotificationTemplate.title: Notification Template
NotificationTemplate.description: Centralized notification wording and personalization template for event categories

actionRoute.description: Target deep link route for notifications generated by this template

updatedBy.description: User UID of admin who last updated the template

CatMemory.title: User Cat Memory
CatMemory.description: Persistent relationship memory, interaction counters, and major milestone history for a specific meme cat and user

catId.description: Unique identifier of the meme cat from the cast registry

userId.description: Firebase user ID of the authenticated user owning this relationship memory

relationshipLevelName.description: Cat-specific title of current relationship level

encounterCount.description: Total number of times this cat has visibly spawned and appeared to the user

meaningfulInteractionCount.description: Total number of meaningful Starlit events and interactive actions shared with this cat

firstSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp when this cat was first encountered

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp when this cat was most recently seen

lastInteractionAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent interaction

milestoneHistory.description: Array of major achieved relationship and encounter milestones

memorableInteractionReferences.description: Array of recent safe interaction references (no private text/photo content)

relationshipState.description: High-level state descriptor of the relationship

unlockedBehaviors.description: Array of unlocked behavior identifiers for this cat

version.description: Schema version identifier for memory records

UserSession.title: User Tracking Session
UserSession.description: Authenticated user session metadata, device details, duration, and activity lifecycle

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier for the browser/tab instance

userId.description: Firebase user ID of the authenticated user owning this session

status.description: Active or ended lifecycle status of the session

lastActivityAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent user activity

durationSeconds.description: Total duration of the session in seconds

initialRoute.description: First route path navigated during the session

currentRoute.description: Current or final route path visited

device.description: Normalized, non-invasive device, browser, OS, and screen metadata

eventCount.description: Total number of batched events recorded during the session

createdAtClientEpoch.description: Client timestamp (milliseconds) when session was created

lastActivityClientEpoch.description: Client timestamp (milliseconds) of most recent interaction

SessionEvent.title: Session Tracking Event
SessionEvent.description: Granular user event batched during an active tracking session

sessionId.description: Session ID this event belongs to

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when event was recorded

CatPreference.title: User Cat Preference
CatPreference.description: User customization preference for a specific cat (custom nickname, visibility, interaction toggles)

customName.description: Optional user custom nickname for this cat

hidden.description: Whether this cat is hidden from spawning (Legendary cats cannot be hidden)

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when preferences were last modified

/notificationTemplates/{templateId}.description: Root collection of admin-managed notification personalization templates

/notificationEvents/{eventId}.description: Root collection of notification events awaiting delivery

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document containing account role and timestamp information

/users/{userId}/activity/{activityId}.description: Collection of activity events recorded by a specific user

/users/{userId}/btsActivity/{activityId}.description: Collection of Behind The Scenes activity records for a specific user

/users/{userId}/catMemories/{catId}.description: Private persistent cat relationship memory and milestone history for a specific user and cat

/users/{userId}/catPreferences/{catId}.description: Private customization preferences (custom nickname, visibility, interaction toggles) for a specific user and cat

/users/{userId}/doodles/{doodleId}.description: Collection of hand-drawn doodles created by a specific user

/users/{userId}/feelings/{feelingId}.description: Collection of feelings written by a specific user

/users/{userId}/letters/{letterId}.description: Collection of letters written by a specific user

/users/{userId}/notificationTokens/{toke.description: Private collection of FCM Web Push device notification tokens for a specific user

/users/{userId}/photoBooth/{photoId}.description: Private collection of photo memories captured by a specific user

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Private collection of tracking sessions for a specific authenticated user

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/eve.description: Private sub-collection of batched events within a tracking session
